# GitHub milestone template

Used to create one GitHub milestone per [release goal](../GAMEPLAN.md#release-goals).

**Title:** `vX.Y - <goal name>`, e.g. `v0.2 - Monorepo setup` or `v2 - Pick-up and drop-off`.

**Description:**

```md
# Description

[maximum 2 sentences describing the release goal]

# Targets

## [stage name]

- [stage milestone]
```

Add one `## [stage name]` section for every stage the goal targets, listing only the stage milestones that belong to this goal.
